provenance.consensus: Zacks consensus for Q1 2026 net revenue 91.69 USD bn and diluted EPS 2.76 USD, published 2026-03-17, as recorded in ILE task O19 (judge-side only)
provenance.net_revenue: Computed as total revenues 109,896 minus TAC 15,228 = 94,668 USD m; the press release does not print a net-revenue line
provenance.derivation: surprise_pct = (actual / consensus - 1) * 100; operating margin = operating income / total revenue * 100; segment margins = segment operating income / segment revenue * 100
provenance.v1_1_changes: forecast scored on net revenue (tol 3%) and TAC (tol 10%) instead of EPS accuracy; segment/operating margins recomputed from filed figures; narrative summary required for reconciliation/verification; audit checks citable docs were read; pass_threshold 0.85.
provenance.v2_changes: forecast expanded to a seven-metric full pre-release model; score is the mean of per-metric linear partial credit; one-off equity-securities gain and core EPS are judged in the verification phase; rubric rebalanced so forecast quality dominates and extraction steps are minor.
provenance.v3_changes: forecast now covers segment operating income as well (nine metrics, equal weights inside the composite); extraction-style checks were demoted and the qualitative rubric was raised.
provenance.v4_changes: v1.4.0/v3.3.1 scoring-validity refactor: weights 55/5/2/2/2/1/2/10/13/8; probabilities became a bounded Brier skill score against a fixed 50% reference (0.25) with explicit binary event outcomes; EPS probability event moved to the core-EPS basis; audit validates per-submission read timestamps; reconciliation validates the submitted consensus and recomputes surprise/beat-miss from the candidate numbers; 10-Q check scores nine filed values and no longer credits a self-reported boolean; forecast composite adds a 10% accounting-consistency factor (TotalRevenue-NetRevenue-TAC within 2.0 USD m); three LLM rubrics (evidence 10, analysis logic 13, handover 8) replace the two 5-point rubrics; peer filings registered as citable read-through documents.

probability_event_definitions.net_revenue_beat: Realized net revenue (total revenues less TAC) exceeds the frozen net-revenue consensus of 91,690.0 USD m by more than +0.5%.
probability_event_definitions.eps_beat: Realized one-off-excluded diluted EPS exceeds the frozen diluted EPS consensus of 2.76 USD by more than +0.5%. This is the same basis as the point forecast; reported GAAP EPS includes an equity-securities one-off that was not knowable before the release and is deliberately not part of this probability event.
probability_event_definitions.reference_note: 0.25 is the fixed mean Brier score of a 50% forecast; it is a fixed reference baseline, not an empirical climatology.

core_eps_methodology.definition: Project-defined analytical metric: reported GAAP diluted EPS less the after-tax effect of one-off equity-securities gains/losses disclosed by the issuer (tax effect as disclosed: 8,200). It is NOT a company-reported figure; implied diluted shares = after-tax gain / per-share impact and is approximate.
core_eps_methodology.consensus_basis: Frozen consensus diluted EPS 2.76 is treated as the benchmark for the one-off-excluded earnings basis (standard analyst convention).

release_only_items: segment operating income for Google Services and Google Cloud
tenq_verification_note.limitation: Release and 10-Q report the same consolidated values for these lines, so verifying the submitted values against the authoritative filed values also verifies 10-Q agreement for them. A byte-level or note-level 10-Q diff is not possible from the judge-side dataset; segment operating income exists only in the release. The reported press_release_matches_10q boolean is recorded as a claim only and is not scored as proof of reconciliation.

citation_valid_conditions: document id exists in the case document registry
a successful read of the document exists in the journal with read at_s <= submission at_s
journal_fields: at_s (end of the action, business seconds)
audit_semantics.note: Reads that happen after a submission cannot retroactively support that submission. Failed reads of unpublished documents and rejected submissions are penalised globally.

scoring_notes.core_eps_vs_gaap: Point forecast and probability events use the one-off-excluded core EPS basis; reconciliation beat/miss uses reported GAAP figures vs the frozen consensus (as reported actuals).
scoring_notes.no_process_gate: No check is must_pass; a single local failure does not zero the case. pass_threshold 0.85 affects the outcome label only.
